messages:
sam g: hey all 👋 i'm Sam, joining Platform this week. I ran `kubectl` but only see 'minikube' in my kubeconfig. I need access to namespaces `platform-dev` and `sam-sandbox`. who should I ping for RBAC + kubeconfig setup?

ana (DevEx): welcome Sam! :wave: pinging @marie from infra. quick checklist: 1) sign into Okta, 2) run `redwood-kube-login`, 3) paste the output of `kubectl config view --minify --raw` if anything looks off.

marie (Infra): hi Sam — added infra here. can you share your AWS/Okta username and which team alias (e.g., platform-team)? i'll open a request to add rolebindings.

sam g: my okta username is sam.g@redwood.ai and team alias is `platform`. attaching output of `kubectl config current-context` -> `minikube` (that's all I see).

infra-bot: request created REQ-2026-376 (kube namespace access for sam.g) — awaiting approval from infra owners.

luis (SRE): quick note: we have an auto-approve flow for new-hires for sandbox namespaces. platform-dev needs explicit RBAC. marie — can you greenlight edit on platform-dev for sam.g for 30 days?

marie (Infra): approved. added a RoleBinding (edit) in `platform-dev` and a RoleBinding (admin) in `sam-sandbox` for user sam.g. should propagate in ~60s.

sam g: ran `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n platform-dev` -> `yes` 🎉 amazing, i can see the namespace now. thanks everyone!

ana (DevEx): awesome — added a quick onboarding snippet to the new-hires wiki: `/docs/onboarding/kube-quickstart` with the commands we mentioned. ping me if anything else.

sam g: will do, thanks :tada:

marie (Infra): if you need port-forward or access to secrets for a short-lived task, open REQ-2026-376 and tag `temporary-access`. we also rotate serviceaccount tokens nightly so low-risk for sandbox.
